Order in Connected Writ Petition
1.
Case called out.
No one is present on behalf of the petitioner in the connected petition.
2. For last few days notice is being placed on noticeboard that all passed over and date fixed matters shall be taken up in first call.
3. No prayer for adjournment has been made on behalf of leaned counsel for the petitioner in the connected matter.

4. Connected petition has been filed challenging the impugned FIR dated 28.2.2024, registered as Case Crime No. 0062 of 2024, under Sections 420, 342, 376, 354, 506 IPC, P.S. Behat, District Saharanpur.
5. Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
6. Connected petition is accordingly dismissed for want of prosecution.
Order on leading Writ Petition 1.

Heard Sri A.K. Singh Baish, holding brief of Sri Chetan Prakash, learned counsel for the petitioners in the leading petition as well as learned AGA appearing for the State respondents and perused the record.

2. Leading petition has been filed challenging the impugned FIR dated 28.2.2024, registered as Case Crime No. 0062 of 2024, under Sections 420, 342, 376, 354, 506 IPC, P.S. Behat, District Saharanpur.

3. After some arguments, learned counsel for the petitioners in the leading petition prays that the petitioners in leading petition may be permitted to withdraw the leading petition with liberty to avail the remedy as may be available to him in law.
4. Prayer aforesaid is allowed.
5. Leading petition is accordingly dismissed as withdrawn with liberty aforesaid.
